title: Cultured cortical networks minimize variational free energy

statements.text: Networks of cortical neurons in a dish, given stimuli mixed from two hidden sources, self-organize as free energy minimization predicts: changes in effective synaptic connectivity lower variational free energy, and connection strengths encode parameters of the generative model.

sources.quote: As predicted, changes in effective synaptic connectivity reduced variational free energy, where the connection strengths encoded parameters of the generative model.
